PLAN "12-Week Vegan Hypertrophy Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "increase muscle mass and strength on vegan diet"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation Hypertrophy" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Push Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Barbell Bench Press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Seated DB Shoulder Press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Incline DB Bench Press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Cable Lateral Raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          Cable Triceps Pressdown 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          Overhead Cable Triceps Extension 2x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          Pec Doorway Stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower 1 Squat Emphasis":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Back Squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          Romanian Deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Leg Press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Walking DB Lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated Leg Curl 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          Standing Calf Raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          Hamstring Stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper Pull Hypertrophy":

          treadmill 8m
